sources.title: Introducing Claude Opus 5.5
sources.evidence: September 22, 2026 announcement names Claude Opus 5.5, gives the claude-opus-5-5 API identifier and describes coding, agentic and knowledge-work uses.

sources.title: Claude Opus 5.5 - Claude Platform Docs
sources.evidence: Exact model page lists September 22, 2026 release, 1M-token context, always-on adaptive thinking, text/image input and text output, and hosted availability.

sources.title: Claude Opus 5.5 System Card
sources.evidence: Full PDF downloaded and extracted after browser content-length failure. Executive summary identifies an Anthropic Opus-class model; section 1.1 describes training and text output. Section 1.4 distinguishes final from earlier/alternate snapshots. Section 6.6.1 describes NLA and template-lens analysis, without model parameter counts or explicit architecture.

sources.title: GLM-5.3 and the spread of advanced cyber capabilities
sources.evidence: September 29, 2026 first-party article explicitly states that Claude weights are not publicly released or customizable. Used only for distribution status.

sources.title: Commercial Terms of Service
sources.evidence: API service terms grant permission to use the service and reserve intellectual-property rights except as expressly stated. Combined with the nonpublic-weight statement, supports descriptive proprietary classification.

sources.title: PDF support
sources.evidence: Official PDF examples explicitly use claude-opus-5-5 with URL, base64 application/pdf and Files API document inputs. PDF processing extracts text and converts pages to images.

sources.title: Tool use with Claude
sources.evidence: Defines function calling and provides exact claude-opus-5-5 examples for both server tools and user-defined client tools, including structured tool_use and tool_result blocks.

sources.title: Anthropic Transparency Hub - Claude Opus 5.5 summary
sources.evidence: Exact Opus 5.5 summary confirms text/image input and text output. Its Model architecture and training methodology section describes pretraining/post-training but supplies no architecture or parameter counts.

sources.title: Claude Sonnet 5.5 System Card
sources.evidence: Full later system-card PDF downloaded and extracted after browser content-length failure. Its exact Opus 5.5 comparisons disclose no total/active production parameter count or architecture; parameter mentions concern evaluation settings.

sources.title: Claude Haiku 5.5 System Card
sources.evidence: Full later system-card PDF downloaded and extracted after browser content-length failure. Its exact Opus 5.5 comparisons disclose no total/active production parameter count or architecture; parameter mentions concern evaluation settings.

name.note: Exact official display name and API identifier.

developer.note: System card identifies Anthropic as the model developer.

family.note: Catalog normalization of the exact system card designation as an Opus-class model.

release_date.note: Announcement and model specifications agree on the date.

open_weights.note: Explicit Claude nonpublic-weight policy applies to this model; hosted availability is separately documented.

license.note: Descriptive classification for a nonpublic-weight model offered under commercial service terms, not a named open-weight license.

parameters_b.note: No total production parameter count found in the full exact-model card, current transparency entry or later Sonnet 5.5/Haiku 5.5 comparison cards. Targeted exact-name primary-source searches found no disclosure. Lower serving compute is not a parameter count.

active_parameters_b.note: No active-per-token production parameter count disclosed in the inspected exact-model and later comparison material. Interpretability-tool dimensions and API effort settings do not supply model parameter counts.

architecture.note: Inspected exact-model and later comparison sources do not identify an architecture. NLA/template-lens use does not itself establish Transformer or dense/MoE structure. No architecture is transferred from other Claude models or experimental checkpoints.

context_window.note: Exact current model specifications give 1M tokens.

modalities.note: Text/image input and text output are explicit. PDF is retained as the supported document format processed into text and page images.

reasoning.note: Dedicated adaptive thinking is always enabled; effort controls its depth.

tool_call.note: Official client and server function-calling examples name the exact model.

description.value: Claude Opus model with always-on adaptive thinking and a 1M-token context window.
description.note: Uses documented features without performance comparisons.

patch.notes: Total and active production parameter counts and architecture are undisclosed in inspected exact-model sources and later Sonnet 5.5/Haiku 5.5 comparison cards. summary: Assessed all 14 fields: 11 verified and 3 undisclosed. Confirms release, context, modalities, reasoning and tool calling; adds proprietary classification and primary-source provenance. Total/active parameters and architecture remain null after full exact-model and later-card checks. Replaces the use-case description with documented features.
